column1: # Instruction patches for Syphon Filter: Dark Mirror (UCES-00310): address, original, new.
# Frame limiter (0x08c2275c): waits a vblank while 1e6 / (frame time in us) is above the target
# frame rate at object+484 (60 at start-up, 30 in the levels: the PSP version runs at 30 fps).
# The logic takes the measured frame time (rounded to 1/60 s, 0x08c20914), so the port
# compares with 60 instead: "lw a1, 484(s0)" -> "ori a1, zero, 60". The PC cap
# (config.ini [video] frame_rate = 30 or 60, settings menu) still limits it in the runtime.
